description:
PR #16 review finding 5: https://github.com/jat10/zaq/pull/16
Reviewed head: 1b2637d9a5284ad7ed3febd9d175288f9dfc6897.

Objective
Reduce duplicated test setup/rendering and unnecessary LOC in the PR's changed tests while preserving every meaningful assertion, behavioral contract and distinct execution path. User explicitly requested a separate issue for this LOC-reduction finding. This is test consolidation, not a coverage reduction target or a production refactor.

Concrete candidates from review (verify current source after fixes)
1. test/zaq_web/components/connection_settings_test.exs: the selector semantics case (reviewed line 9) and inactive-controls/section-headings case (line 44) render essentially the same Main/Advanced editor. Use one fixture/render and retain selector semantics, pressed state, inactive control values, section headings and absence of nested forms/submit buttons assertions.
2. test/zaq_web/components/file_delivery_settings_test.exs: the embedded-heading case (line 100) can fold heading-suppression assertions into the existing presentation variations (line 113). Retain both heading-present and heading-absent coverage, plus the policy-control assertion; do not drop a distinct no-metadata behavior accidentally when consolidating fixtures.
3. test/zaq/channels/api_test.exs: the separate SMTP/IMAP file-metadata inspection case (around line 2424) overlaps the existing provider table exercising the same endpoint (around line 2485). Add the metadata/no-file-support assertions to those existing scenarios where equivalent, avoiding repeated setup. Keep the complete raw SMTP declaration contract in email_bridge_test.exs and retain endpoint-specific normalization coverage.

Scope and safeguards
- Inspect only PR-introduced/expanded tests and immediately relevant existing cases. Extend the above candidate list only when a concrete same-contract duplication is demonstrated.
- Prefer additional assertions in existing cases, straightforward parameterized variations, and small local fixture helpers. Avoid an abstract test framework or large multi-scenario tests that obscure failures.
- Keep transaction rollback, proposed-versus-persisted configuration, stale-capability recovery and each distinct save boundary independently tested. In particular retain the regression coverage added for findings 1-4.
- Preserve exact assertions and scenarios unless the user explicitly approves a disclosed behavioral change. This request authorizes consolidation, not weakened expectations or removal of distinct cases. Follow docs/testing-approach.md for existing-test behavior approval when a proposed rewrite changes what is verified; do not treat moving unchanged assertions as permission to change their meaning.
- No arbitrary LOC target. Report net changed-test LOC and cases/setup eliminated, together with the assertion/contract preservation evidence. Do not trade readability or isolation for a smaller number.

Action/function reuse assessment
No domain operation changes or new Actions/tools are needed. Reuse the existing test suites, fixtures and assertions. Evaluate helper extraction against docs/code-quality.md function reuse decision; keep helpers local unless broader reuse is established.

Acceptance and validation
- Demonstrably duplicated setup/rendering is removed with all affected contracts still covered.
- Test isolation, async behavior, fixtures and mock expectations remain correct; do not introduce shared mutable test state.
- Run mix q and isolated affected suites through Context Mode, including affected regression tests from findings 1-4. Report results and net LOC reduction.
- Do this pass after the relevant findings 1-4 edits settle so consolidation reflects final behavior. No speculative infrastructure or unrelated test sweep.
- Follow parent pending review/coverage/UX/E2E/final-validation gates. This issue does not authorize commits, pushes, merges or restarting previously deferred final precommit.

Agent handoff
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/code-quality.md and docs/conventions.md; read docs/documentation.md before changing comments or documentation. Review current diff and issues zaq-h2i.3.15 through zaq-h2i.3.18 before consolidating their coverage. User requested issue creation and an execution handoff prompt in this turn; no implementation or delegation was performed.
